name: BounceBit CeDeFi Yield
notes: BounceBit-Labs org has chain node/SDK repos (bouncebit-chain-node, bitswap SDKs) but no subgraph/indexer for the CeDeFi yield product. No public indexer found.

name: Aave Horizon RWA

repos.scope: Official Aave V3 subgraph codebase; Horizon is an Aave v3.3 market deployment (aave/aave-v3-horizon contracts) indexable via the same config-driven subgraph. No Horizon-specific deployment config confirmed in repo.
repos.verified: WebFetch github repo: active public TypeScript subgraph indexing Aave V3 across many networks/markets (AGPL-3.0, 279 commits, ongoing). Horizon is the RWA market variant of Aave v3.3.

notes: Aave Horizon = Aave v3.3 RWA market (contracts at aave/aave-v3-horizon). Official Aave subgraph repo indexes V3; Horizon market covered by same codebase though a dedicated Horizon deployment config was not explicitly confirmed.

name: PancakeSwap AMM V3

repos.scope: PancakeSwap V3 exchange: Factory(PoolCreated), pools, swaps, mints, burns, NonfungiblePositionManager positions across BSC/Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Linea/zkSync/Polygon zkEVM/opBNB/Scroll.
repos.verified: git clone --depth 1: template/subgraph.template.yaml has V3 Factory + NonfungiblePositionManager dataSources; schema.graphql has Pool/Tick/Position/Mint/Burn entities; config/ has per-chain v3 factoryAddress for bsc, ethereum, arbitrum, base, linea, zksync-era, polygon-zkevm, opbnb, scroll.

notes: Official PancakeSwap V3 subgraph. Also pancakeswap/pancake-subgraph for blocks/prediction/NFT.

name: CIAN Yield Layer
notes: CIAN exposes a private vault-history REST API (docs.cian.app) but no public subgraph/indexer git repo found. No public CIAN GitHub org with indexer.

name: Euler V2

repos.scope: Euler V2 (EVK vaults, EVC, EulerSwap) across mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, Swell, Sonic, Ink, Berachain, Bob, Unichain, Avalanche, BSC.
repos.verified: WebFetch github repo: contains schema.graphql + generated subgraph.yaml, /contracts and /abis, multi-network deploy scripts; official euler-xyz org repo, updated May 2026 (84 commits on simple-subgraph branch). Euler docs reference this as the official subgraph incl. eulerSwapPools queries.

notes: Official Euler Labs subgraph repo; docs.euler.finance points to it. Subgraphs also hosted on Goldsky + The Graph.

name: Bedrock uniBTC
notes: Bedrock-Technology/uniBTC is a public repo but smart contracts only (Solidity/Python, CCIP/celer/oft cross-chain dirs); no subgraph.yaml/schema.graphql/ponder. No public indexer found.

name: Coinbase Wrapped Staked ETH
notes: cbETH is an ERC-20 wrapped staked-ETH token; Coinbase open-sourced the token contracts (wrapped-tokens-os) but there is no dedicated public subgraph/indexer for cbETH. No public indexer found.

name: Re
notes: Re (re.xyz) tokenized reinsurance (reUSD). No official public subgraph/indexer repo found; rwa.xyz lists Re but is a third-party analytics platform, not Re's own indexer.

name: cap
notes: cap-labs-dev org (cap-contracts, cap-docs, cap-yearn-strategies, etc.) has no subgraph/indexer/ponder repo. Note: an unrelated older protocol '0xcap' has CAP v1/v3.1 perp subgraphs - NOT this cap.app stablecoin protocol. No public indexer for cap.app found.

name: Upshift
notes: Upshift vaults powered by August Digital, which deploys 2 'Lending Pools' subgraphs (Ethereum + Arbitrum) on The Graph (docs.augustdigital.io/developers/subgraphs) - hosted endpoints, no public source git repo found. No public indexer repo found.
